_readme: Non-secret updater settings. Environment variables with the same meaning override these. The bot token is NEVER stored here; it only comes from the ATMOSPHERE_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable / GitHub secret.
_gallery_skip_jpeg: Minecraft screenshots are PNG. JPEGs posted in #showcase are phone/camera photos (holidays, food, desk setups) and are kept off the public site.
_gallery_exclude_message_ids: Discord message IDs whose images must never appear on the site (right-click message > Copy Message ID).
